entries.back_en: "Afraid of heights? I'm a Wyndian -- we love high places."
"You didn't get hurt, did you? I'm sorry. I didn't tell you about my wings... I can use them to fly a little, so I survive a fall like that."
entries.note: 'ficou?' as the tag question is awkward/unnatural; better 'nao foi?' or 'ne?'.
